annotations.title: US oil and gas inventories (EIA weekly)

description: The week in US oil and gas from the EIA's weekly reports: crude (commercial, Cushing, the SPR), gasoline, distillate, jet fuel and propane stocks with the change on the week and the year and against the five-year average and range for the week; refinery utilization; production, trade and products supplied (demand) over four weeks; natural gas in storage by region against a year ago and the five-year average. by_district adds PADD districts; stock gives one stock week by week. Summary first. No key.

by_district.description: Also crude stocks, refinery runs and utilization by PADD district.

report.description: oil: the weekly petroleum report (Wednesdays); gas: the weekly natural gas storage report (Thursdays); default both.

stock.description: One stock week by week against its five-year average and range, instead of the report.

weeks.description: Weeks shown for stock, latest last; default 26.

name: energy_report

outputSchema.description: summary is the week in plain sentences; oil has stocks (million barrels, with the five-year average, low and high for the same week), supply (thousand barrels a day, with four-week averages) and refining; gas has working gas by region (billion cubic feet) with EIA's year-ago and five-year comparisons. With stock, rows are weeks (oldest first) in the order of columns.

title: US oil and gas inventories (EIA weekly)
